summary: Champion duels: a tie is challenged only by a Duelist against a non-Duelist (any other tie or higher stat is passed on); challenged by a lower duel stat the champion always accepts and Strikes at its first opportunity, in DuelOpponent (game duel screen) and TrainingOpponent scoring (tournaments).
validation: New and updated ChallengeGuardTests pass; full L5R.AI.Tests 199/199; format check clean.
remaining: Not measured in bot-vs-bot play against the previous champion; ChallengeGuard=false restores the old challenge behaviour (the accept-and-strike reply has no switch). Duel modifiers beyond table values are not counted.
